description: This PHP source file defines a console command class 'InstallOnNewDatabaseCommand' within the OrangeHRM project. It handles the installation process of a new database, including user prompts, system checks, database setup, and configuration file generation, as part of the OrangeHRM human resource management system's installer.

classes.name: InstallOnNewDatabaseCommand
classes.description: A console command class that orchestrates the multi-step installation process of a new database for the OrangeHRM system, including user prompts, system checks, database creation, privilege verification, migration, configuration, and final setup.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Entry point for the command execution; verifies interactive mode and whether the system is already installed, then executes the installation logic.

methods.name: executeCommand
methods.description: Performs the full installation process, including license acceptance, database info collection, system checks, instance creation, admin user creation, and installation steps.

methods.name: getAppSetupUtility
methods.description: Returns the AppSetupUtility instance, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: licenseAcceptance
methods.description: Prompts the user to accept the license agreement before proceeding.

methods.name: databaseInformation
methods.description: Collects database host, port, database name, user credentials, and optional data encryption setting; validates and stores info.

methods.name: systemCheck
methods.description: Performs system environment checks, including permissions, and prompts user if any checks fail.

methods.name: instanceCreation
methods.description: Guides the user through providing organization details, country, language, timezone group, and timezone, and stores this information.

methods.name: adminUserCreation
methods.description: Collects admin user details such as name, email, contact, username, password, and registration consent, then stores them.

methods.name: installation
methods.description: Executes the core installation steps: creating database, verifying privileges, running migrations, inserting configuration, creating DB user, and generating config files, with user prompts and progress updates.
